branding.title: Branding
branding.headerDescription: Customize your organization's visual identity. Changes are saved when you click Save; you can see a preview while you edit.
branding.resetConfirm: Restore the theme to the Didacta default values?
branding.colorDescription: You move the hue and the saturation; the 10 palette steps are derived automatically over HSL.
branding.saturationHint: Low saturations give pastel tones; high saturations, vibrant colors.
branding.typographyDescription: Sora + Inter is the Didacta default. Other combinations are limited to Google Fonts compatible with the system hierarchy.
branding.logoDescription: Upload the tenant logo directly to storage or paste an external URL (https).
branding.uploadedHint: The logo is stored in the tenant storage. To change it, upload another file.
branding.uploadHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP. Maximum 2 MB. Drag or click to select.
branding.uploadBadType: Unsupported format. Upload PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP.
branding.uploadError: We could not upload the logo.
branding.removeConfirm: Delete the uploaded logo? You will go back to the Didacta wordmark.
branding.removeError: We could not delete the logo.
branding.logoUrlHint: If you paste an external URL here it will override the uploaded logo (on save).
branding.signinDescription: Copy for the dark panel of /signin. If you leave it empty, the generic Didacta text is used. The figures shown below (active students, published courses) are real and calculated automatically: they are not configured here.
branding.headlinePlaceholder: Applied AI training, with the community that uses it every day.
branding.headlineHint: Maximum 160 characters. It renders very large: a short sentence works best.
branding.subheadlinePlaceholder: Courses, community and live classes in one place.
branding.cssDescription: For technical users only. It is sanitized on the server: @import, expression(), javascript: and closing {styleTag} are blocked. Maximum 16 KB.
branding.footerDescription: Footer HTML (sanitized to basic tags). It appears at the bottom of authenticated screens. Maximum 4 KB.
branding.previewDescription: This is how your brand looks on the platform. Changes apply live.
branding.saveNotice: On save, the changes will affect every user in your organization.
branding.upsellDescription: The tenant's custom CSS and HTML footer are part of the Didacta Enterprise white-label package. Your current plan (community) does not include this feature.
branding.upsellBody: With an active Enterprise license you can inject your own CSS rules, replace the footer with custom HTML and hide the Didacta brand. The required capability is feat:white_label.

config.title: Tenant settings
config.description: Credentials and module preferences for your organization. Secrets are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and are never returned in plain text by the API.
config.loadError: We could not load the settings. Try refreshing the page.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete {setting}? If it was a credential, the associated integration will stop working.
config.deleteError: We could not delete the setting.
config.rawDescription: Lists every value stored in tenant_setting grouped by module. The normal path is to configure each thing from its specific tab (Notifications, Storage, etc.). This view is useful when you need to review/clean up orphaned settings. Values marked as secret ••• are encrypted at rest and cannot be read from the UI by design; only the server decrypts them when consuming them. Delete removes the whole setting and disables the associated integration.
config.rawEmpty: You have not configured anything in this tenant yet.

modulesTab.loadError: We could not load the modules.

modulesTab.cascadeWarning: If you confirm, those modules will also be disabled in cascade.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: File backend for uploads (avatars, certificates, lessons, evidence). The container's local disk or an S3-compatible bucket (AWS, Hetzner, MinIO, Backblaze).
storage.localDirHint: Make sure to mount a Docker volume pointing to this path so the files survive redeployments.
storage.endpointHint: Only needed for non-AWS S3-compatible providers (Hetzner, MinIO, Backblaze).
storage.secretKeyPlaceholder: (leave empty to keep the current one)
storage.secretKeyHint: It is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before persisting. The API never returns it in plain text.
storage.s3Required: Bucket and Access Key ID are required for S3.
storage.saveError: We could not save the storage configuration.
storage.activeNote: Active: image uploads and tenant files already use this configuration when the driver is s3. If you choose local disk or leave the bucket empty, the server falls back to the global env adapter.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Organizations using Didacta. Only super_admin can create new tenants and assign custom domains.
tenants.loadError: We could not load the tenants.
tenants.createLockedTitle: Your community plan already has one tenant. Activate Enterprise to add more.
tenants.emptyDescription: Create the first one to start giving an organization access.
tenants.capacityEe: Enterprise · multi-tenant active. Current tenants: {count} · no limit.
tenants.capacityCe: Community plan · you use {count} of {limit} tenants. Activate Enterprise to create several isolated organizations on this same instance.
tenants.upsellDescription: Your community plan has {count} of {limit} tenants. To host several isolated organizations on the same instance (separate data, users, courses and domains), activate Enterprise.
tenants.upsellBody: The required capability is feat:multi_tenant.real. If your Enterprise license expires or is revoked, the existing tenants are kept, but NO new ones can be created until you renew.

tenantNew.title: Create tenant
tenantNew.description: Set up a new organization with its first admin and a primary domain.
tenantNew.cardDescription: After creating it, the first admin will receive an email with a link to set their password and sign in.
tenantNew.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. No spaces.
tenantNew.hostnameHint: Where signin and signup will live. It can be a Didacta subdomain or a custom domain (in that case configure the CNAME externally).

dominios.title: Custom domains
dominios.description: Lets your organization access Didacta through a custom domain (e.g. learn.acme.com) instead of the shared subdomain.
dominios.loadError: The domains could not be loaded.
dominios.addError: The domain could not be added. Try again.
dominios.verifyError: The domain could not be validated.
dominios.statusError: The status could not be changed.
dominios.deleteError: The domain could not be deleted.
dominios.addDescription: Enter the hostname without protocol (e.g. learn.acme.com). Once added, configure a CNAME at your DNS provider pointing to the indicated target and press Validate.
dominios.empty: You have not added any custom domain yet.
dominios.dnsTitle: Configure your DNS and press Validate:
dominios.dnsTxt: Add a TXT record at <mono>_didacta-challenge.{hostname}</mono> with the value:<tokenCode>{token}</tokenCode>
dominios.dnsNote: Note: in this pilot the validation runs when you press the button. Automatic DNS verification (DNS-01 challenge cron) will arrive in a later iteration.
dominios.upsellDescription: Custom domains are part of the Didacta Enterprise package. Your current plan (community) uses the shared subdomain {slugHost}; with Enterprise you can serve your LMS from your own hostname (e.g. learn.acme.com).
dominios.upsellBody: The required capability is feat:custom_domains. If your Enterprise license expires or is revoked, validated domains become inert and users keep accessing through the shared subdomain — the saved configuration is NOT deleted.
